title: EXAMINING THE ALIGNMENT OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS THROUGH REPRESENTATIVE HEURISTICS: THE CASE OF POLITICAL STEREOTYPES
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates Large Language Models using the Moral Foundation Questionnaire (MFQ), which captures human moral values across dimensions such as harm/care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and purity. It explicitly analyzes how LLMs emulate and potentially exaggerate these moral and ethical positions compared to human survey data.
